verification.note: CONFIRMED unchanged 2026-08-25. Annual Primary Threshold 12,570 and Upper Earnings Limit 50,270 quoted directly as yearly figures; employee rates 8% then 2%. Note gov.uk also publishes weekly 242/967, which annualise to 12,584/50,284 - the yearly figures above are authoritative for an annual calculation (see spec 7.4).

notes: Employee Class 1 only. Employer NI is not a deduction from employee pay and is deliberately excluded.
Bands apply to gross earnings, NOT to income after the Personal Allowance. NI has its own thresholds and is calculated independently of Income Tax.

The Primary Threshold currently coincides numerically with the Personal Allowance. That is a coincidence of policy, not a shared value — keep them as separate fields so one can change without the other.
